name: mmu.ac.uk
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 5000 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.
lesson: Serve sitemap.xml from the same host as the pages it lists, and name it in robots.txt.
summary: www.mmu.ac.uk scores 68 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 37 pass. Fix first: 5000 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 5000 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: mmu.ac.uk (5000). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.mmu.ac.uk.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: CookieYes was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Quantcast (3 requests), LinkedIn Insight (3 requests), Snap Pixel (1 request), and cookies X-AB on sc-static.net, __Secure-YNID on youtube.com, YSC on youtube.com,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Reject" and reloading, LinkedIn Insight (8 requests), Quantcast (6 requests), Snap Pixel (3 requests) still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: 26 images below the first screen load straight away
fix.evidence: close.svg on /, poweredbtcky.svg on /, students-looking-at-phones-in-brooks-35… on /, 34080054.jpg.webp on / and 22 more. They compete with the first screen for bandwidth.
fix.fix: Add loading="lazy" to images below the first screen, and keep it off the main image.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
